crew.name: Quartermaster
crew.text: Draw 2 extra cards on the first turn of each round.

crew.name: Tallyman
crew.text: Your cards with an even flat (0 counts) get ×1.25 when they score.

crew.name: Shade
crew.text: At the start of turn 4, you may flip one revealed card of yours face down.

crew.name: Salvager
crew.text: Once per round, when a card of yours is destroyed, you may discard a card: the destroyed card returns to your hand at the end of the turn instead of going to your pile.

crew.name: Veil
crew.text: Once per match, when a card of yours is destroyed, you may flip every revealed card you control face down instead; none of them is destroyed.

crew.name: Navigator
crew.text: Whenever a card of yours is moved, it gets +1 flat this round.

crew.name: Gardener
crew.text: When a round ends, each card on your row gets +1 flat for the match.

crew.name: Lookout
crew.text: Whenever a card of yours returns to your hand or flips face down, draw a card.
